source_files.extracted_scope: Wave 1 CSM physical-selection lower bound and source configuration snapshot

facts: The CSM collection has been accumulated unevenly since approximately 2013 across multiple editions.
The Wave 1 New Recruit roster is explicitly not the complete physical collection.
Additional models and kits remain unassembled/on sprues.
Historical edition changes make current unit/loadout mapping non-trivial.
Some source selections require later physical clarification rather than immediate normalization.
Two Dark Vengeance starter sets were purchased.
One Dark Vengeance Helbrute was converted into the World Eaters collection with plasma replacing the original melta-type ranged weapon.
The second Dark Vengeance Helbrute is painted as Alpha Legion and has fist + melta-style starter loadout.
Two Dark Vengeance Chaos Lords and two sets of old-sculpt Chosen are owned.
All 40 currently recorded CSM Cultists originate from the Dark Vengeance starters.
Two Shadowspear starter sets were purchased, plus additional models from the same release lineage.
Six Greater Possessed are owned.
Five current-release Possessed are on sprues.
Ten Gal Vorbak and one Argel Tal are owned and can represent Possessed for the user's CSM army.
Of four Obliterators, three are assembled and one is still on sprue.
Ten Shadowspear CSM are directly observed on a complete sprue and seven more are assembled but unpainted.
A separate Legionaries Kill Team themed as Word Bearers was built; exact body count remains to be recorded.
Both generic Chaos Lords are Dark Vengeance sculpts; one is damaged.
All 12 Dark Vengeance Chosen are present and retain starter loadouts.
The previously unresolved three Shadowspear CSM bodies were transferred into the Word Bearers Legionaries Kill Team; user recalls two bolter bodies and one heavy-bolter body.
The Word Bearers Kill Team was built from newer Chosen bodies plus some Shadowspear Legionaries.
Six Greater Possessed split as two assembled/painted and four on sprue.
Ten Gal Vorbak and one Argel Tal are primed/base-coated and currently unbased.
The World Eaters Dark Vengeance Helbrute retains the original fist as its melee arm.
The winged CSM Daemon Prince is the same physical Black Legion-styled winged Daemon Prince already recorded in chaos_daemons.

product_references.concise_fact: Chaos side contained 1 Chaos Lord, 6 Chosen, 1 Helbrute and 20 Chaos Cultists.
Chaos side contained 1 Master of Possession, 10 Chaos Space Marines, 1 Venomcrawler, 2 Obliterators and 2 Greater Possessed.

notes: Raw New Recruit export is not vendored because it contains extensive copyrighted rules text; checksum and normalized collection facts are retained.
The collection must be reconciled by physical body first, then build state, then current-role mapping. Current 11E squad legality must not be used to erase historical physical builds.
This file is intentionally a durable Wave 1 checkpoint, not a claim of collection completeness.

Wave 2 established Dark Vengeance and Shadowspear acquisition provenance, added legacy/proxy Possessed-role bodies, and promoted several build-state facts while retaining unresolved overlap and missing-body gates.

Wave 2 closeout resolved the two Dark Vengeance Lords, all 20 Shadowspear CSM acquisition bodies, Greater Possessed build state, Gal Vorbak/Argel Tal state, World Eaters Helbrute fist, and winged Daemon Prince cross-domain identity. Current unique CSM-domain lower bound: 151.

reconciliation_notes: Two boxes explain at least 2 Masters of Possession, 2 Venomcrawlers, 4 Obliterators, 4 Greater Possessed and 20 monopose Chaos Space Marines by acquisition history.
Current physical observation directly located 10 CSM on a complete sprue and 7 assembled/unpainted; three bodies from the nominal twenty remain to be reconciled.
The user's third Master of Possession is consistent with additional purchases but its exact acquisition source is not yet recorded.
